label: caiso 28 stgas hrfix
definition: CAISO keeper. Fixes the ST_GAS/CT_PEAKER merit inversion: AES Alamitos (315) and Huntington Beach (335) are pure-steam OTC units whose EIA-923 plant heat rate was CC-blended by a colocated CCGT under the same ORIS (315->8.49, 335->7.33, both below the CT_PEAKER median ~10.07), so they cleared ahead of CA peakers. MIXED_FACILITY_STEAM_HR recovers their measured pure-steam value 11.85 (sister plant Ormond Beach 350, same AES Southland OTC fleet, no CC). Result: ST_GAS drops into band (~4.5->~1.1 TWh vs actual 1.38; off the C1 fail list both 2023/2024) and system CO2 tightens (-0.6%/+1.4%/+5.3%, all PASS). Benchmark uses the EIA-930 geo+biomass gas fold-in deflation (classFull gas ~74/73/70 TWh). Reproduces the run-25 corridor-deliverability keeper config (gas-hub-basis-overlay, per-hub intertie + corridor deliverability cap, import gas coupling, RA gas commitment floor 0.80, negative renewable offers) plus the two fixes. CAVEAT: CT_PEAKER stays under-dispatched (~0.4 vs ~4 actual) and CC_REGULAR now slightly over (+3 TWh) — the freed ST_GAS energy is absorbed by cheaper CC, not peakers; a separate CC-over-dispatch / missing-CT-reliability-commitment gap to pursue, not a reason to revert the grounded HR fix (rule #11).
